verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a dedicated Test environment that replicates the full functionality of Live and lets developers simulate real-time transactions, compliance scenarios, authorizations, refunds and statements before going live (highnote-docs-11, highnote-docs-26). That covers sandbox testing kept apart from production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of data and credential isolation between Test and Live (e.g., separate API keys), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity.
